text: FoundationScale validates a training topology before an allocation is burned.
A gate that cannot fail is not a gate; every check here has a positive control.
Tensor parallelism splits one model replica across several accelerators.
Pipeline parallelism splits a model by layer depth across stages.
Data parallelism replicates the model and shards the batch.
Expert parallelism places mixture-of-experts experts on different devices.
Context parallelism shards the sequence dimension across ranks.
A checkpoint is adjudicated at save time, not discovered broken at load time.
An unmeasured claim is reported as UNMEASURED, never as clean.
The cluster is data, not code: describe the machine in a profile.
Exit codes are 0 PASS, 5 RED, 95 UNMEASURED, 96 REFUSE.
Machine facts have no defaults; the framework fails closed instead of guessing.
A save gate runs on every checkpoint the trainer writes.
Declared topology is compared against the topology the runtime actually built.
Model-specific behaviour stays out of the core training loop.
Reproducibility means the run manifest can rebuild the argv that produced it.
